findings: failure retains exact beforeSettlement including internal logs and partial effects. Represented storage rollback restores current write view while created/read metadata remain from current state; no claim full account/code/transient rollback is proved.

Caught exceptional case uses restore before forfeit, empty output and execution0, baseline reservoir, spill/refund0 and unchanged committedSpill. The classification premise excludes builtin conversion and owner assertion; uncaught preserves its partial tuple without issuing an EVM receipt.
REVERT retains exact output and internal observations, applies restore without execution forfeiture, restores represented current storage and suppresses logs/warm contribution.

Failure logsForParent=[] and warmForParent=none describe source incorporation suppression, not internal evm.logs clearing. Success contributions drop incoming replay prefix; success_logs requires and uses exact prefix concatenation, preventing inherited logs duplication.

failed_evaluation extracts the SAME computed prefix and exact failing dispatch tuple before settlement. It does not manufacture a desired partial world or equate attempted logs with committed records.
open_boundaries: snapshot is an explicit supplied storage projection; source pre-message snapshot identity is documented but not derived by this helper.
incomingLogs identity/prefix property and terminalWarm binding must be supplied by actual context/prefix producers; success_logs is intentionally conditional.
Full source rollback for account/code/transient state, actual frame/context extraction and parent/world linkage remain open.
Receipt is a local represented projection; eligible logs can still be discarded by ancestors, and no unique occurrence/canonical history claim follows.
